title: House Price Prediction
description:
Build a linear regression model to predict house prices.
Your program must:
1. Be contained in a single script.
2. Load the dataset from 'house_prices.csv', which will be in the same directory as your script when run.
3. Define a function named `predict_prices(train_data_path, test_features)`.
   - `train_data_path` will be the path to the CSV file.
   - `test_features` will be a pandas DataFrame with 'Size' and 'Bedrooms' columns for which to predict prices.
   - This function should return a NumPy array of price predictions.
4. You must use pandas and scikit-learn.
